data.title: Add Review status for bugs
data.body:
## Goal

Add a `Review` status for bugs where implementation is complete but code review is pending.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `Review` variant to `Status` enum
- [ ] `docket review ID` transitions InProgress → Review
- [ ] Review bugs show distinctly in `docket list` (e.g., purple)
- [ ] `docket list --review` filters to only bugs in review
- [ ] `docket done ID` from Review state works normally
- [ ] Consider `docket reject ID` to go Review → InProgress

## Context

The current flow jumps from InProgress directly to Done. In practice, there's often a code review step in between. Having an explicit Review status makes this visible.

Status flow becomes:
```
InProgress → Review → Done
               ↓
           InProgress (rejected)
```

## Log
